notes:
• MXG Scout is back to doing one job really well: viewing MOBOTIX .MXG recordings and converting them to MP4 for YouTube. The live-camera features have been retired — MxControlCenter already does live viewing, and keeping MXG Scout focused makes it faster and easier to use.
• The ribbon is now three clean tabs: Home, Convert and Help.
• Everything about watching and converting is unchanged — open, scrub, fast-forward/rewind, frame-step, trim, snapshot, full screen, sound, and one-click MP4.
